description: MCPAgent configuration (python mcp/agent.py): the agent, and the MCP server it starts for itself.
Validated against schemas/mcpagent.schema.json; paths are relative to the repository root.
server: the MCP server, which serves the shared agents/tools folder. The agent starts it as a
child process when it starts, talks to it over stdin and stdout, and stops it when it exits.
tools_dir: the tool manifests (<tool>/tool.json); each tool is named after its folder.
tools_env: environment variables every tool gets, e.g. which agent runs it.
client: the agent: its log level, the shared context files and the MCP servers it uses.
instructions_file, models_file, output_file, agent_file: shared by all three agents;
agent_instructions_file: MCPAgent's own name and instructions, added to the shared ones;
--profile, --local or --openai picks a model profile, else models_file's "default".
server_output: show the server's log lines (started, each tool it ran, errors) with the other
gray lines, with -d; off by default.
servers: a STDIO entry without "config" starts the server section's server; an entry with
"config" names another MCP server: a command (STDIO) or a URL (HTTP).

server.description: Serves the shared agents/tools folder over MCP.

servers.description: The shared agents/tools folder, served by the server section above.
